intro.text: A master Allomantic metallurgist in Luthadel who makes experimental alloys for Vin.

items.text: Though no Allomancer himself, he spent most of his life making alloys and metal powders for Allomancers and became an acknowledged master of the trade. After the Lord Ruler's fall, Vin enlisted him to find a usable alloy of aluminum; he gathered the rare metal and drew up a list of forty possibilities.

His first four alloys were useless and made Vin ill when she burned them. After Straff Venture's army arrived, he bought the dinnerware of a fleeing noble family for its aluminum, mixed it with four percent copper to make duralumin, and sent a supply to Vin's rooms in Keep Venture with a note. It worked.
